Located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="HNN50" /> the '''Mon Calamari Embassy''' was the official embassy of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], the procession for former [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cha Niathal]]'s [[Funeral of Cha Niathal|funeral]] started from the embassy.<ref name="backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>
